question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.**
solution:
The correct answer is:** if**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'If'** is used to introduce a possible or unreal situation or condition.

 
 
• **Example -** *She gets very upset** if **I exclude her.*
 
 
 
• ​We use **'if'** in **conditional sentences** to introduce the circumstances in which an event or situation might happen, might be happening, or might have happened.
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is** 'if'.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct Paragraph:__ *Dust storms do not just happen in the middle of the desert. They can happen in __any__ (1) dry area where loose dirt can __easily__ (2) be picked up. Don't be surprised **__if__ (3)** you suddenly saw a dust storm (4)_________ your way. Dust storms usually (5)________ without warning.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Whether** is used in reference to a choice or alternatives.
 
• **So** is used as subordinating conjunction to introduce clauses of result or decision.
 
• **Until** is used as subordinating conjunction to connect an action or an event to a point in time.
